title: Pick the first MIP backend that is really there
heading: Each API Has Its Own List of Backends, and Only Some Are Compiled In
cases: a commercial solver the machine lacks is passed over for the next preference that is present
of several present MIP solvers, the earliest in the preference list is chosen
an LP-only solver is passed over even though it is present, since it would drop the integer variables
when no preference is a present MIP solver, the answer is None rather than a solver nobody asked for
